title: Accessory layer — 5 starter accessories + mount sockets + recipe field + spring sway

stories.title: 5 named mount sockets on the bomber tree (head.crown / head.eyes / torso.back / torso.sideL / torso.sideR)
stories.summary: Promoted from GDP-2026-05-22-003. Extend the procbomber-bench bomber-tree-spawner with mount socket positions computed from sizes. The sockets are LOCAL positions in the parent mesh's frame: head.crown sits on top of head, head.eyes on its front face, torso.back on the back face, torso.sideL/R on the side faces. Pure positional helpers + tests; no entities created yet.
verification: acceptance: examples/procbomber-bench/src/accessories/mount-sockets.ts exports MOUNT_SOCKET_NAMES (5), MountSocket type, computeMountSockets(sizes). All 5 sockets (head.crown, head.eyes, torso.back, torso.sideL, torso.sideR) have parentSuffix + local position derived from BomberPartSizes.
+8 unit tests covering name count, predicate, position math, mirror symmetry, scale-with-sizes

stories.title: 5 starter accessory mesh generators (antennae / visor / backpack / cap / fins)
stories.summary: Promoted from GDP-2026-05-22-003. Each accessory exports a pure `generate<Name>Accessory(palette)` returning one BufferGeometry. All share the existing 8-channel palette (accent for highlights; head/torsoTop for body fill). Antennae = 2 thin cylinders on head.crown. Visor = wide thin box across head.eyes. Backpack = small box on torso.back. Cap = wide shallow capsule on head.crown. Fins = pair of triangular plates on torso.sideL+R. Pure helpers + tests for vertex counts + color usage.
verification: acceptance: 5 starter accessory generators ship (antennae / visor / backpack / cap / fins). Each returns one BufferGeometry with vertex colors from the existing 8-channel palette. accessoryKey(kind) emits the procedural-mesh-registry key 'procbomber-accessory-<kind>'.
examples/procbomber-bench/src/accessories/catalog.ts: ACCESSORY_KINDS + isAccessoryKind + accessoryKey + per-kind generate*Accessory functions + generateAccessory dispatcher
+8 unit tests covering kind count + key format + non-empty vertex output + accent/torsoTop channel usage + vertex budget (<400 each)

stories.title: CharacterRecipe.accessories field + codec round-trip
stories.summary: Extend CharacterRecipe schema + TypeScript type with `accessories?: BomberAccessory[]` where BomberAccessory = { kind: AccessoryKind, mountSocket?: MountSocket }. AccessoryKind = 'antennae' | 'visor' | 'backpack' | 'cap' | 'fins'. Default mount per kind (cap → head.crown, etc); explicit mount override permitted (visor → torso.back for cosmetic-only debug). Validator accepts 0..3 accessories per recipe. encodeRecipe / decodeRecipe round-trips. resolveRecipeFromSeed picks 0..2 accessories deterministically from the seed.
verification: acceptance: CharacterRecipe.accessories?: BomberAccessory[] (0..3) supported through schema + TS + codec. resolveRecipeFromSeed picks 0..2 deterministic accessories. encodeRecipe/decodeRecipe round-trips preserve them. validateRecipe rejects >3 or unknown kind/socket.
examples/procbomber-bench/schemas/character-recipe.schema.json: accessories field with kind enum + socket enum + maxItems=3
examples/procbomber-bench/src/character-recipe.ts: BomberAccessory type + ACCESSORY_DEFAULT_SOCKET + resolver/validator/defaults extended; +5 unit tests

stories.title: Bomber tree spawner adds accessory entities under their mount sockets
stories.summary: spawnBomberTree extends to also walk `recipe.accessories` and spawn one entity per accessory: parented to the named mount socket's parent mesh entity (head / torso), with the socket's local position offset, MeshRenderer pointing at `procedural:procbomber-accessory-<kind>` (six new procedural mesh keys registered by bench / kaboom-crew). Each accessory carries a 'SoftAttached' tag component so the spring system can apply secondary sway. Per-recipe accessory list returned from the spawner so the bench rebuild loop can iterate them.
verification: acceptance: spawnBomberTree extends with accessories[] option. Each entry spawns one entity (or 2 for fins-pair) parented to its mount socket's owning mesh (head or torso). Mesh ref points at procedural:procbomber-accessory-<kind>[#seed]. SoftAttached tag + default-rest SpringPivot stamped on each accessory.
examples/procbomber-bench/src/bomber-tree-spawner.ts: accessories option + accessoryEntities in BomberTreeResult; DEFAULT_SOCKET_BY_KIND map; fins spawns mirrored right entity via scale.x = -1
examples/procbomber-bench/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json: SoftAttached tag component
examples/kaboom-crew/src/procbomber-integration.ts: registerProcbomberBuilders also registers the 5 accessory builders; spawnBomberFor passes recipe.accessories
+5 unit tests covering no-accessories/one-accessory/fins-pair/SoftAttached tag/mesh ref format

stories.title: Soft-attached entities sway via SpringPivot driven by parent motion
stories.summary: When a SoftAttached entity's parent moves or rotates between fixedUpdates, infer an angular nudge (velocity delta) and stamp it into the entity's SpringPivot.velocity. The spring-pivot-system (from S105) then decays it back to rest. Net effect: accessories visibly trail behind their parent's motion — cap wobbles when bomber walks, fins flex on direction change. Per-entity tracking of parent's last-frame world transform via a small cache in the system.
verification: acceptance: soft-attach-sway-system queries [SoftAttached, Transform, SpringPivot] each fixedUpdate + diffs parent's LocalToWorld.position against the previous tick. Linear delta → angular nudge written into SpringPivot.velocity; spring system decays it. Per-entity tracking caches parent position by parent id.
examples/procbomber-bench/src/systems/soft-attach-sway-system.ts: linearDisplacementToAngularNudgeDegPerS pure helper + createSoftAttachSwaySystem ECS wrapper
examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts: createSoftAttachSwaySystem registered BEFORE createSpringPivotSystem
+8 unit tests covering helper math + system loop (first-tick no-prev, X motion → Z nudge, stationary parent stays at rest, no-SoftAttached skip)

stories.title: Bench overlay gains an Accessories section — 3 multi-select dropdowns
stories.summary: DOM overlay extension. New 'Accessories' section between Shape and Palette. Three independent dropdowns (slot 1 / slot 2 / slot 3); each picks one of {none, antennae, visor, backpack, cap, fins}. State written to bench-state.accessories; rebuild loop re-runs the spawner under a transient 'accessories' branch (delete + recreate accessory entities only — keep the body tree). Pure DOM cosmetics + 1 unit test on the dropdown wiring.
verification: acceptance: bench panel gains 'Accessories' section with 3 independent dropdowns (slot 1/2/3); each picks one of {none, antennae, visor, backpack, cap, fins}. On change, rebuild loop diffs desired vs spawned accessory kinds + re-spawns the accessory branch only (body tree stays).
examples/procbomber-bench/src/bench-state.ts: BenchState.accessorySlots + accessoriesOf helper
examples/procbomber-bench/src/bench-ui.ts: buildAccessorySelect + 'Accessories' section rendered before Palette

examples/procbomber-bench/bootstrap.ts: rebuild loop step 3d detects accessory kind diff + deletes previous accessory entities + re-spawns. ACCESSORY_KINDS / accessoryKey imports registered with proceduralMeshRegistry alongside body parts

stories.title: Kaboom Crew's makeKaboomRecipe seeds 0..2 accessories per bomber
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts: makeKaboomRecipe(ownerId) currently sets only paletteName. Extend it to call resolveRecipeFromSeed so player.1 and bot.1 each get their seed-derived 0..2 accessories. Visual outcome: in-game bombers have visible variety beyond palette — one carries a backpack, the other wears a cap, etc.
verification: acceptance: kaboom-crew bombers get seed-derived accessories without bootstrap changes — makeKaboomRecipe already calls recipeForOwner which calls resolveRecipeFromSeed (now picks 0..2 accessories per S106-3). spawnBomberFor (S106-4) passes recipe.accessories to spawnBomberTree. Net effect: player.1 and bot.1 each get distinct accessory loadouts from their entity ids without further bootstrap-side wiring.
Verified end-to-end by tests/unit/character-recipe.test.ts > resolveRecipeFromSeed picks 0..2 deterministic accessories
